2609.04511.title: LentEx: Generalizable Latent Entity Extraction via Synthetic Data and Instruction-Tuned LLMs
2609.04511.paper_summary: Latent entity extraction (LEE) tackles the challenge of identifying implicit, contextually inferred entities within free text-an area where traditional entity extraction methods fall short. In this paper, we introduce LentEx, a novel framework for latent entity extraction that leverages synthetic data generation and instruction fine-tuning to optimize smaller, efficient large language models (LLMs). Latent entities, which are often abstract and thematic, are crucial for applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), customer persona analysis, and knowledge graph enrichment. LentEx addresses the scarcity of labeled datasets by employing a template-based approach to generate diverse, contextually rich synthetic data, ensuring high variability and alignment with real-world distributions. To our knowledge, LentEx is the first to systematically approach LEE through the lens of LLMs. LentEx demonstrates significant performance improvements across multiple tasks, notably surpassing state-of-the-art models on the MTEB Clustering Benchmark. Furthermore, our methodology enables robust generalization to unseen domains, making LentEx highly applicable in real-world NLP tasks, including RAG and clustering, thereby establishing a new paradigm for latent entity understanding and extraction in natural language processing.
2609.04511.paper_summary_zh: 潛在實體提取（LEE）解決了在自由文本中識別隱含的、上下文推斷的實體的挑戰——這是傳統實體提取方法無法滿足的領域。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了LentEx，一個新穎的潛在實體提取框架，利用合成數據生成和指令微調來優化較小、高效的大型語言模型（LLMs）。<lb/>潛在實體通常是抽象和主題性的，對於檢索增強生成（RAG）、客戶角色分析和知識圖譜豐富等應用至關重要。<lb/>LentEx通過採用基於模板的方法生成多樣化、上下文豐富的合成數據，以解決標註數據集稀缺的問題，確保高變異性並與現實世界分佈對齊。<lb/>據我們所知，LentEx是首個系統性地通過大型語言模型的視角來處理LEE的框架。<lb/>LentEx在多個任務中顯示出顯著的性能提升，特別是在MTEB聚類基準上超越了最先進的模型。<lb/>此外，我們的方法論使得對未見領域的穩健泛化成為可能，這使得LentEx在現實世界的自然語言處理任務中高度適用，包括RAG和聚類，從而為自然語言處理中的潛在實體理解和提取建立了一個新的範式。
